subject: general
question: Arabari forest is located in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Midnapore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Arabari forest is located in the Midnapore district of West Bengal, India.
 
• It is known for its success in joint forest management and community-based forest conservation.
 
• The forest covers an area of 1,272 hectares and is predominantly comprised of Sal trees.
